title: Diego Pavia didn't have agent for NIL, has agent for NFL

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Diego Pavia didn't have agent for NIL, has agent for NFL
sources.description: As undrafted Heisman finalist Diego Pavia continues to wait for his first NFL opportunity, we've done a little more digging on the question of whether he is indeed proceeding with the help of an agent and, if so, why he would create the impression that he's not represented.
